# Shared scode ACP package

Canonical source: `sudoprivacy/sudocode`, `sdk/typescript`.
Current pinned source: `70118705ce2742ffdf17452f632faca8cb4ff98f` (PR #1031).

The versioned npm archive is generated by the canonical package's clean-source
`npm test` / `npm run pack:runtime`. Its adjacent receipt records source,
SHA-256 and npm integrity; package-lock.json also pins archive integrity.
This is a generated dependency, not a second editable ACP implementation.
To update, validate a reviewed canonical source, copy its archive and receipt
into a new source-prefix directory, update both application dependencies and
regenerate the lock. Do not edit or rebuild common code inside Hydra.

Hydra's core and CLI re-export the same installed `@sudocode/acp` module. The
MCP command passes Hydra's existing shutdown owner into that shared module.
The package is already bundled; application packaging includes it through the
normal production dependency closure rather than rebundling another copy.
